items.prompt: Define aerobic respiration.

items.prompt: Describe a complete investigation, using a respirometer, to show that germinating seeds take up oxygen.
items.canonical_answer: Compare living germinating seeds with the same volume of boiled (dead) seeds or glass beads. Measure the distance the coloured droplet moves towards the seeds in a set time. Keep the temperature the same by standing both tubes in the same water bath. Put a carbon dioxide absorbent, such as soda lime, in each tube behind a gauze, so that droplet movement shows oxygen uptake. Repeat with fresh seeds and calculate a mean distance.
marking_guidance: 1 mark: changes the independent variable: living germinating seeds compared with boiled seeds or glass beads of the same volume.
1 mark: measures the dependent variable: the distance the droplet moves (or the volume of gas taken up) in a set time.
1 mark: keeps one named variable the same, such as temperature (in a water bath) or the volume of seeds.
1 mark: uses a carbon dioxide absorbent in each tube, so the droplet moves only because oxygen is used.
1 mark: repeats the readings and calculates a mean.

items.prompt: Suggest a limitation of a leaking seed respirometer and a linked improvement.
items.canonical_answer: Outside air leaks in and replaces the oxygen used, so oxygen uptake is underestimated. Seal the joints and test for leaks before taking readings.

items.prompt: Describe how strenuous exercise leads to lactic acid accumulation in muscle.
